summaries.v1-0067: Grant of permission to the Abbot of the Premonstratensian monastery of Monsterii to use a portable altar for celebrating Mass in private houses or chapels under specific conditions.
summaries.v1-0100: Felix V appoints Johannes de Cotarello as his mint master (monetarius) and aggregates him to the consortium of other mint masters, requiring him to take an oath before the vice-chamberlain.
summaries.v1-0106: Dispensation granted to Nicolaus, a clerk and beneficiary of the altar of St. Catherine in Wilgattwiesnen, allowing him to receive all sacred orders successively on different days from any bishop in communion with the See of Basel, due to the brevity of time and risk of losing his benefice.
summaries.v1-0108: The Pope appoints Johannes Bonintempis, a canon, as a scribe of the papal chancery, granting him all associated privileges and ordering the Bishop of Augusta to admit him to the office.
summaries.v1-0157: Felix V grants the commendatory administration of the priorate of Saint Peter of Castelleto to Johannes Martinus de Advocatis de Casmana, abbot of the Cluniac monastery, to provide him with a pension of 400 florins.
summaries.v1-0301: The Pope accepts the resignation of the abbot of the Monastery of Vallis Dei and appoints Reginaldus Rosselleti, prior of St. Nicholas in Bosco, as the new abbot.
summaries.v2-0016: The Pope grants a petition from Amedeus Carles Laiti to relax a corporal oath he made in a sale of property, which he claims was extracted under duress and fraud by Peter Fonte Aciam Laitus and a Jew named Crois San, and orders the addressee to execute this relaxation.
summaries.v2-0021: The Pope orders the Prepositus of St. Dalmatius in Turin to accept the resignation of Paulus Melgnesius from the parish of St. Mary of Vinfiso and to install Andreas Lomberdus in its possession, while reserving an annual pension of 40 florins for Paulus.
summaries.v2-0089: Pope Felix V mandates the Bishop of Montis Regalis and others to install Jacobus Roverii in the vacant parish church of Saint Benedict in the Diocese of Belley, overriding any prior claims or letters.
summaries.v2-0279: The Pope revokes previous letters regarding the order of procession for the Orders of Preachers and Minorites in Burg in the Diocese of Lyon, restoring the previous custom of equal deference to avoid discord.
summaries.v3-0022: Felix V grants a special dispensation to Andreas Perolerius, a cleric of the Diocese of Tournai, to receive the parish church of Saint Julian in Berriacum, which is being resigned by its rector Petrus Perolerius, despite Andreas being under the canonical age of 25.
summaries.v3-0041: The Pope mandates the Archbishop of Vercelli to investigate and, if suitable, install Gabriel de Solano de Carisio in the vacant parish of Mauritius of Carisio, overriding any contrary claims or reservations.
summaries.v3-0071: Pope Felix V grants a dispensation to Bishop Philibert of Lausanne to install the underage cleric Nicodemus Wicherius into the vacant chapel of the Holy Trinity at Meldino, waiving the age requirement and other canonical impediments.
summaries.v3-0169: Dispensation for Stephen Paveti Mochus to retain the priorate of the Monastery of Saint Sugedi despite his minority (age 16), following the resignation of the priorate by Ludovicus de Grateur and the subsequent transfer of the beneficiary to the Monastery of Saint Michael of Clusa.
summaries.v3-0306: The Pope grants a special dispensation to Peter de Chastangy to receive the chapel of St. Peter in the parish church of Bonainferion, which was previously held by Thomas Chesnelot, overriding any prior reservations or general provisions.
summaries.v4-0010: Pope Martin V grants Cardinal John authority to confer the degree of Baccalaureate in Theology and license to lecture at Lausanne to Humbert Anselm, a Franciscan friar, despite contrary statutes.
summaries.v4-0084: Pope Felix V grants a dispensation to Philippus de Composio, a canon of Lausanne, allowing him to hold a canonry and prebend despite being under the age of 25, and reserves the provision of the prebend to the Apostolic See.
summaries.v4-0115: Grant of a special benefice in the Diocese of Basel to Johannes Werner de Virenhusen, with provisions regarding the value of the benefice and the reservation of rights for the Bishop of Basel.
summaries.v4-0197: The Pope orders the Official of Geneva to compel a creditor in Geneva to return pledged goods and accept satisfaction for a debt owed by Michael de Gebenno and Petrus Dolerius, under pain of excommunication.
summaries.v4-0247: Felix, Bishop of Lausanne, grants a special grace to Theodericus Mignericus to accept a vacant ecclesiastical benefice in the Diocese of Tullensis within ten months, reserving it against the claims of the local chapter.
summaries.v4-0257: Pope Felix V grants the prepositus and canons of the Monastery of St. Leonard in Basel permission to wear specific vestments (vario grises and asperiolis) in processions, overriding previous privileges of the Cathedral Chapter.
summaries.v4-0328: Pope Felix V orders the abbot of the monastery of Saint Cuthbert (or similar) and the brothers of Montis Regalis to confer a reserved benefice in the church of Ostentibus to Antonius de Castrelle.
summaries.v5-0082: Felix V grants a dispensation from personal residence to Peter Vial, rector of the parish church of Cloysia in the Diocese of Geneva, allowing him to retain the fruits and revenues of the benefice while serving as chaplain to Cardinal Francis of Saint Marcellus, provided a vicar is appointed to care for the church.
summaries.v5-0083: Pope Felix V requests alms for a poor priest from Lugano who was robbed while on pilgrimage and grants a 40-day indulgence to donors for the construction of an Augustinian monastery in Thonon.
summaries.v5-0154: Pope Felix V commissions Cardinal Bernard of Basel to hear and decide an appeal filed by Johannes, prepositus of the church of St. Maurice in Anseltingen, against a judgment rendered by Michael in favor of Ernestus.
summaries.v5-0173: The document records the induction of Girardus de Rupe and Reginaldus Johannes into vicariates in Lausanne and confirms the testamentary faculties previously granted to Cardinal Ludovicus de Sancta Dusanna.
summaries.v5-0260: The Pope grants the parish of Quarto in the Diocese of Aosta to Johannes Audree, despite previous reservations and claims by other parties.
summaries.v6-0005: The Pope grants a dispensation to the inhabitants of Montis de Gla, exempting them from ecclesiastical citations, excommunications, and other molestations during the winter months due to the danger of travel to their parish church.
summaries.v6-0008: Pope Felix V confirms the assignment of the chapel of St. Mary of Spinerano to the hermit Dominic Pagii, overriding the claims of Amedeus de Columbis and the Abbot of St. Maurice.
summaries.v6-0025: Pope Felix V adds apostolic firmness to acts concerning the protection of churches, monasteries, and regulars, at the petition of Johannes de Arerex and his relatives.
summaries.v6-0131: The Pope grants a special dispensation to Antonius, a minor (18 years old), to hold a perpetual chaplaincy in the Church of Augusta, despite his lack of priestly orders, and orders the official to provide him with possession of the benefice.
summaries.v6-0137: Felix V, Bishop of Geneva, commits the administration of the Hospital of the Little Smiths and its chapel to Johannes, Prior of Saint Helena, following the death of the previous rector, and grants him the right to retain the benefice.
summaries.v7-0024: A letter of recommendation and favor from Pope Felix V to Bartholomew John, rector of the Church of St. Mary in the Diocese of Geneva, acknowledging his service and fidelity.
summaries.v7-0037: Pope Felix V grants an indulgence of 41 days to those who contribute alms for the repair and conservation of the hospital in Faverrier, which was damaged by brigands and is currently in need of restoration.
summaries.v8-0014: The antipope Felix V grants Paris de Fossano, a canon of the Monastery of St. Peter of Manzario, the priorate of St. Andrew of Savilliaro, reserving a pension of 60 ducats for Cardinal Bernard of the Four Crowns, and orders the bishops of Lausanne and Belluno to induct him into possession.
summaries.v8-0018: Confirmation of the rights of Thomas Dondani, Dean of Aliguier, to hold various benefices in the dioceses of Geneva and Lausanne, despite claims of vacancy or irregularity.
summaries.v8-0156: The Pope mandates the Bishop of Geneva to confer the canonry and prebend of the Church of Saint Stephen of Bugella to Augustinus de Reyria, reserving the benefice and ensuring his possession.
summaries.v8-0177: Pope Felix V grants the prior and convent of the Augustinian monastery of Ripaille in the Diocese of Geneva the right to present canons to six specific parochial churches upon vacancy, reserving these benefices for the support of the monastery's religious.
summaries.v8-0214: Pope Felix V grants absolution and confirms the provision of the parish church of Secusia to Stephanus Vernay, a monk of the monastery of Saint Just, who had taken possession of it after the resignation of the previous secular prebendary.
summaries.v8-0274: Pope Felix V confirms the provision of the canonry and prebend of the Church of Saints Mary and Ivenalis in Turin to Antonius de Gernavasio, following the resignation of Ludovicus de Illié and the removal of the current holder Matheus Ruffinus.
